title: WPSS/1394/2017 of Baladatt Nainwal AND OTHERS Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND ANOTHER

paras.text:
WPSS No. 1394 of 2017
Honíble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Mr. B.D. Upadhyay, Sr. Advocate, assisted
by Mr. Sunil Upadhyay, Advocate for the
petitioners.
Mr. Vikas Pande, Brief Holder for the State.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.
Petitioners, who were serving as Teachers
in Government Schools have filed this writ
petition claiming benefit of replacement scale in
terms of Government Order dated 01.03.2009,
for the purpose of re-fixation of their pension.
Learned counsel for the petitioners
submits that present lis is squarely covered by
the judgment dated 17.02.2017 rendered by a
Division Bench of this Court in WPSB No. 72 of
2017.
Learned Deputy Advocate General does not
dispute this statement of fact, made by learned
counsel for the petitioners that the matter is
covered by judgment rendered in aforesaid writ
petition.
Accordingly, the writ petition is disposed of
in terms of the judgment cited hereinabove. The
respondents are directed to grant benefit of
replacement scale to the petitioners, in terms of
Government Order dated 01.03.2009, for the
purpose of refixation of their pension.
